note: Per-case script outcome, endpoint reach and the local golden execution of every generated suite in the README tables. Extracted from the git-ignored runs/ folders (scripts/manifest.json, testcases.json, coverage/coverage.json, executions/x-01/results.json). passed = passed its dry run on the correct version; suspected = assertion failed and kept after review; invalid = no valid script. An endpoint counts as reached when V8 coverage saw its handler run or (Planka) a passing script sent the request.
